subject: UPDATED: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI FOR MONDAY, JUNE 15, 2026
plaintextBody:
City Seal 170

June 15, 2026  

*FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY*    

*CONTACT:* pressoffice@cityhall.nyc.gov     

    

*UPDATED: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI*    

*FOR MONDAY, JUNE 15, 2026*  

    

"On Monday, Mayor Mamdani will appear on NY1. " 

"" 

"Then, the Mayor will appear live on HOT 97 Mornings with Mero (97.1 FM).  " 

"" 

"After, the Mayor will appear live on SiriusXM NBA Radio’s The Starting Lineup. " 

"" 

"Next, the Mayor will appear on WNYC’s The Brian Lehrer Show. " 

"" 

"Then, the Mayor will visit New York City Department of Transportation’s (NYC DOT) Sign Shop to assist with parade preparations. This event is open to press. " 

  

"After, the Mayor will visit a child care center to make parade decorations. Footage of this event will be pooled by ABC7 and distributed after the stop."   

"" 

"Later, the Mayor will receive the James Park Morton Interfaith Award at The Interfaith Center of New York. This event is closed to press." 

 

_*Press Schedule*:_" "    

** 

*9:00 AM (Approx.) — Appears on NY1 *  

  

*9:05 AM (Approx.) — Appears live on HOT 97 Mornings with Mero (97.1 FM)*   

 

*9:15 AM (Approx.) — Appears live on SiriusXM NBA Radio’s The Starting Lineup* 

 

*10:00 AM (Approx.) — Appears on WNYC’s The Brian Lehrer Show *  

 

*10:00 AM – Visits NYC DOT Sign Shop to Assist with Parade Preparations* 

"58-50 57th Road, Maspeth, NY 11378. " 

"The Mayor will take questions at this event." 

  

*2:00 PM – Visits Child Care Center to Make Parade Decorations* 

"Footage of this event will be pooled by ABC7 and distributed after the stop."   

  

*7:40 PM – Receives the James Park Morton Interfaith Award at The Interfaith Center of New York* 

"This event is closed to press." 

"" 

Photos will be available here [ https://www.flickr.com/photos/nycmayorsoffice/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ].
